decisions.reason: An evening psychiatric day program fits the firm's core mental-health care mission, is financed through statutory insurance, and has its own web page, which signals commitment.
The custom furniture carpentry workshop gives participants work integration and earns some revenue, and its dedicated page suggests it is an established part of the offering.
Outpatient sociotherapy complements the psychiatric services and is reimbursable, though it is only mentioned on the website and may face staffing constraints.
Senior living counseling is shown on the home page, low-cost, and draws in residents for the core residential care business.
A retail outlet for sheltered workshop goods supports inclusion and sales, but retail costs and low visibility make it somewhat more vulnerable.
